member.summary: Book an appointment as a guest
member.remarks: Send first name, last name and email along with clinic ID, speciality ID, doctor ID, start time and duration. Birthdate and message are optional. An existing patient with the same email is reused. Returns the appointment with status Booked. Access: this endpoint does not require authentication in the current implementation.
